sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN SPANISH (formerly the HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN SPANISH LANGUAGE AND HISPANIC CULTURES)
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Languages, Cultures, and Linguistics

Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 3.0 principal courses (including Spanish 1030 or successful completion of Grade 12U Spanish). 2.0 additional principal courses must be taken with no mark below 60%.
3.5 courses from: Spanish 2100 level or above.
2.5 courses from: Spanish 3100 level or above.
